question: Require emulator or physical-device process-death proof before merging this external Android sticky-service fix, or explicitly waive that gate?
rationale: The implementation matches the existing lifecycle architecture and focused tests cover the races, but the contributor has not observed the actual OS-managed restart path.

options.title: Require real restart proof
options.body: Ask for redacted emulator or physical-device logs or a recording showing process death, null-intent recreation, runtime activation, and Gateway reconnect.

options.title: Waive with owner sign-off
options.body: An Android owner explicitly accepts the deterministic lifecycle tests and reviewed platform assumptions as sufficient.

recommendation.title: Require real restart proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted emulator or physical-device logs or a recording showing process death, null-intent recreation, runtime activation, and Gateway reconnect.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the active assignee and review requester and appears in recent history for the affected Android paths.
